Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human MCH receptor 1 (CHEMBL344). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records to activities for compound_key. Join docs to activities for pubmed_id and doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce the SMILES requirement. Filter by target CHEMBL344, standard_type IC50, and presence of both canonical_smiles and at least one of pubmed_id or doi. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
